name: scrutiny-fabric-tools
//biome: Pinned exactly, not ^: the D12 crypto-import ban is a biome nursery rule, and a minor bump that promotes or renames it would silently stop enforcing it. test/no-crypto.test.ts backs the ban independently.

scripts.verify: pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm rules:check && pnpm ownership:check && pnpm knip && pnpm build && pnpm publint && pnpm api-report:check && pnpm attw && pnpm size && pnpm audit && pnpm test

pnpm.//pnpm: Security floors on transitive dev-dependency chains. qs >=6.16.0 (via @stryker-mutator/core -> typed-rest-client) carries GHSA-q8mj-m7cp-5q26, GHSA-x5fp-wj9c-mxmx, and GHSA-4mjr-xmp4-gh2g. brace-expansion >=5.0.12 and source-map-js >=1.2.2 close remaining moderate advisories reachable from the dev toolchain. vite is pinned exactly at 6.4.5: vitest 4.1.x resolves its vite edge to a 6.4.3 snapshot that a range override cannot lift under pnpm 9, and 6.4.3 carries the launch-editor/fs.allow advisories. zod >=4.6.6 (via @stryker-mutator/core -> mutation-server-protocol) closes its memory-exhaustion advisory; fast-uri >=3.1.9 (via @microsoft/api-extractor -> ajv) closes four low/moderate URI-parsing advisories. The js-yaml / nanoid / esbuild pins of earlier history are gone: changesets 3 replaced the js-yaml chain and no remaining chain resolves vulnerable versions. All are dev-only, never shipped: @scrutiny-fabric/core has diff as its sole runtime dependency.
